reader.requirement: Each successful WRITE on a sequential file open OUTPUT or EXTEND must hand its logical record to the file so that it is part of the physical file a later OPEN (after CLOSE, or after STOP RUN's implicit CLOSE) reads, in every record form 1985 allows (fixed, RECORD VARYING); an unsuccessful WRITE (not open, wrong mode, GR8 size violation) releases nothing. At 1985 no second connector can observe the file while it is open (a sibling OPEN answers 41), so the release is observable only through the file's content after close; the witness covers the fixed-length OUTPUT case only.

edition-consulted.switches: via SharingFacilityInEffect (DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility, from 2002): at 85 false, so ReleaseRecord does not flush per WRITE; the record stays in the writer buffer until CloseCore flushes it
c.SharingFacilityInEffect: at 85 any second connector's OPEN of an open physical file answers 41 before c.Open; from 2002 Table 19 arbitrates (61)
FileSharingFacility: at 85 the default sharing is AllOther (host share mode only)

reader.edition-search: grep of DialectBehavior, Edition, SharingFacilityInEffect in SequentialConnector.cs, FileConnector.cs, FileRegistry.cs; the write path itself (WriteRecord) takes the same arm at every edition apart from the flush decision in ReleaseRecord
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a record is buffered until CLOSE and no sibling connector can open the file to see it (41); from 2002 a sibling admitted by Table 19 forces a flush per WRITE. The observable content after CLOSE is the same.

reader.notes: Release at 1985 is the buffered write plus the flush in CloseCore (explicit CLOSE, or CloseAll at STOP RUN); with no file sharing facility and 41 on any sibling OPEN, no connector of the run unit can observe the buffer, so buffering until CLOSE conforms. Comment drift, not behaviour: the summary of SequentialConnector.cs#EnsureReaderCoherent and the OUTPUT arm of SequentialConnector.cs#OpenCore still say that at COBOL-85 a sibling OPEN OUTPUT is admitted and truncates, which the 41 arm in FileRegistry.SharedOpenAttempt now refuses (probe p7a: SIBLING OUTPUT 41).

The uncommitted removal of NoteRelease() from SequentialConnector.OpenCore's OUTPUT arm does not bear on GR7: it announced a truncation, not a release, and at 85 no reader can be open beside an OUTPUT (r3-001 'SIBLING OUTPUT MID-READ 41'); not probed on a rebuilt tree (the build is the pin's).
